Numbers 4:4.bridge: God assigns each Levite clan (Kohath, Gershon and Merari) its share of the work of carrying the tabernacle.

Numbers 7:89.bridge: Over twelve days, the leader of each tribe brings an identical dedication gift of silver, gold, incense and animals.

Numbers 15:27.bridge: God gives Moses further laws for life in the promised land, including the grain and drink offerings and atonement for sins committed unknowingly.

Numbers 25:6.bridge: God sends a plague on the people, and Moses orders the judges to execute those who joined in the worship of Baal of Peor.

Numbers 26:51.bridge: After the plague, God orders a second census of the fighting men, taken tribe by tribe on the plains of Moab near Jericho.

Numbers 29:1.bridge: God sets out the offerings for each day, sabbath, new moon, Passover and the feast of firstfruits.
